title: SCOPE: Evaluating and Enhancing Permission Explanation Transparency in Mobile Apps
abstract: arXiv:2611.32122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Permission explanations, explanatory text accompanying mobile app permission requests, are crucial for user privacy transparency and informed consent. Despite their importance, current practices often fall short of regulatory expectations due to the lack of systematic evaluation mechanisms. Through an empirical study of 600 mainstream mobile apps, we reveal widespread deficiencies: 15\% of permission requests provide no explanation, others use vague language or technical jargon, and critically, many fail to disclose third-party SDK data access despite these components actively using granted permissions. To address these transparency gaps, we present SCOPE, an automated multi-agent framework that systematically evaluates permission explanation compliance and generates targeted optimization recommendations. translated_title: SCOPE：评估与增强移动应用中权限说明的透明度
translated_abstract: 权限说明是伴随移动应用权限请求而出现的解释性文本，对于用户隐私透明度和知情同意至关重要。尽管意义重大，但由于缺乏系统性的评估机制，当前的实践往往无法达到监管预期。通过对600款主流移动应用的实证研究，我们揭示了普遍存在的缺陷：15%的权限请求未提供任何解释，另一些则使用模糊语言或技术术语，更为关键的是，许多应用未能披露第三方SDK的数据访问情况，尽管这些组件正在积极使用已授予的权限。为了解决这些透明度缺口，我们提出了SCOPE——一个自动化多智能体框架，能够系统性评估权限说明的合规性并生成有针对性的优化建议。SCOPE采用四个专业化智能体协同工作：基于多模态大语言模型的说明提取、基于少样本学习的……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对600款主流移动应用的实证研究揭示了权限说明存在的普遍缺陷（如缺少解释、表述模糊、未披露第三方SDK数据访问），并提出了名为SCOPE的自动化多智能体框架，用于系统性评估权限说明合规性并生成优化建议。
en_tdlr: Through an empirical study of 600 mainstream mobile apps revealing widespread permission explanation deficiencies (missing explanations, vague wording, undisclosed third-party SDK data access), this paper proposes SCOPE, an automated multi-agent framework that systematically evaluates permission explanation compliance and generates targeted optimization recommendations.
